title: Bitcoin ETF inflows reach $3.52B in August, best month of 2026
dek: Bitcoin ETF inflows totaled $3.52 billion in August 2026, the strongest month of the year. The inflow reduced year-to-date net outflows from approximately $5.29 billion to $1.77 billion as Bitcoin gained 25%. Ether ETFs turned positive year-to-date at $732 million, and XRP ETFs reached $502 million.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $3.52 billion in August inflows, their best month of 2026, after the asset itself gained 25% over the same period.
bottom_line: August's $3.52 billion inflow required an earlier cumulative outflow of approximately $5.29 billion to produce the remaining $1.77 billion net outflow year-to-date. The sustainability of this capital rotation will become clear if September's volatility (historically the sector's most difficult month) reverses the momentum or if institutional allocations remain committed to spot products.
body: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $3.52 billion in inflows during August 2026, their strongest month of the year, according to Cointelegraph's reporting. The inflow reduced the year-to-date net outflow position to $1.77 billion, a reversal of capital flight earlier in the year. Bitcoin gained approximately 25% during August, according to Cointelegraph.
Institutional capital also returned to Ether and XRP ETF products. Ether ETFs turned positive year-to-date at $732 million in cumulative inflows, per Cointelegraph.

August's inflows stand in contrast to the trading patterns of the first seven months of 2026, when the desk's ETF flows board showed cumulative net outflows across major spot products. On September 1, the desk's board recorded a net outflow of $236.5 million, though the last five trading sessions showed a cumulative inflow of $252.8 million, indicating divergence between recent daily activity and the monthly trend.
